headline: AMBER: easy day only, and the plan has nothing after the race. It needs a new block.
summary: Readiness is AMBER. On its own numbers today would be GREEN: HRV 59, RHR 48 and sleep 7.1h (score 79). But HRV fell 17 overnight (76 to 59), and any drop over 10 makes it amber. Tonight's 7.1h of sleep came after only 4.8h on 18 Nov and 5.9h on 17 Nov, so sleep debt is the likely cause again, not load. Fitness is CTL 52.0 / ATL 41.1, so you're fresh (TSB about +11). Nothing is planned: the Valtellina block ended with the race on 7 Nov (22.1km, 2h14, avg HR 172) and the plan has no sessions after it. Today's call: if you run, 40min easy, Z1-Z2, staying at 155bpm or below, with no strides and no hills. If there's a bike, a 45min Z2 spin (134-147bpm) works instead. Rest is also fine. Yesterday's Bucharest run (10.5km, 53min) averaged 156bpm, which is Z3. At RPE 4 that's the usual easy-day drift, so hold the 155bpm cap today. Since the race you've done two big outings with no plan: 24.9km on 11 Nov (load 138, feel 4 = Poor) and 19.6km / 1188m D+ on 15 Nov (load 142, RPE 8). Volume is fine, but it isn't structured toward anything.
flags: The plan has no sessions after 7 Nov. Point it at the next race (race, baseline, targetRaceCtl and weeks in both plan files) in a coaching session.
Easy-run drift: 18 Nov averaged 156bpm (Z3) at RPE 4.
Sleep debt: 4.8h on 18 Nov and 5.9h on 17 Nov, now a 17-point overnight HRV drop.
